name: theme-switcher
description: A source-owned Dioxus-only palette switcher for Dioxus (no shadcn equivalent), backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Dioxus-only extra with no shadcn equivalent -- classified `EXISTING_DIOXUS_EXTRA`-style per design.md §7b (no shadcn/dioxus-components catalog counterpart in statics/component_compatibility.json). One combined palette picker (a Select over the Slate/Blue/Violet/Emerald/Rose/Amber presets, each option previewed as three overlapping primary/secondary/accent swatches) that recolors all three semantic role groups' raw custom properties together as one coordinated choice, depending on the installed `select` registry item for the picker itself -- productizing the concept prototyped in apps/playground's advanced customization tray, which keeps its own full 28-token editor unchanged. The selected preset persists across reloads via adico_primitives::persisted_state::use_persisted_global (localStorage on web, a preferences file on native), the same generic primitive theme_mode's own light/dark/system persistence is built on, so every mounted instance shares and survives the same choice.
documentation.accessibility: Each role picker composes the installed `select` item's Select/SelectTrigger/SelectList/SelectOption parts, so it inherits that component's WAI-ARIA APG listbox-popup pattern, roving-focus keyboard navigation, and typeahead -- see `select`'s own documentation for the full contract.
documentation.keyboard: Inherited from the installed `select` item: Enter/Space/ArrowDown opens the trigger, Arrow keys move the roving highlight, Enter/Space selects, Escape closes.
